prompts.prompt: Can the PowerDNS Authoritative Server perform recursive DNS lookups on behalf of clients? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/powerdns/SKILL.md - PowerDNS Auth does NOT perform recursive lookups; it answers only for zones it is authoritative for
